persona.name: The Ringleader
persona.line: Over a third of your week was subagents working for you. Delegation isn't a skill, it's a lifestyle.

firsts.name: release-notes
firsts.detail: Writes customer release notes from the week's merged pull requests
firsts.example: can you turn everything merged this week into release notes for customers? Plain words, no ticket numbers

firsts.name: Google Calendar
firsts.detail: Lets Claude read the calendar to plan and prepare for meetings
firsts.example: check my calendar for tomorrow and give me a one-line brief for each meeting

firsts.name: Published a plugin
firsts.detail: Packages skills as a plugin colleagues can install in one click
firsts.example: can you turn these skills into a plugin and publish it to [my company's] org… make sure it's the latest version

firsts.name: 10 agents at once
firsts.detail: The most subagents started in one go, for the build research below

cards.title: Drafting code changes and pull requests on GitHub

examples.text: this change touches billing, which makes me nervous… can you get 5 agents to review it from different angles before I open the PR?
[a colleague] says the nightly build keeps failing… get 10 agents to find out why → put what they found in a spreadsheet, one tab per failing job, with a link to each run
this PR is too big to review… split it into 3 smaller ones that each make sense on their own, and update the ticket
add short comments to the PR explaining each file, for someone who has never seen this part of the code

cards.title: Looking into things and answering questions

examples.text: I've been in meetings all morning… catch me up on where we are, what's done and what's left
something doesn't add up… if this bug were real we'd have far more support tickets. Get 5 agents to check all the evidence so far
find everything we've written about onboarding in Notion and Slack, look at what other companies do, then tell me how we could make our guide better
can you pull sign-ups by week from Mixpanel and tell me whether the new landing page made a difference?
[a customer] says the sign-up button does nothing on their phone… can you check it in the browser at phone size?
here's the transcript from our planning meeting, turn it into a page with the decisions, who owns what and the open questions
write up the outage: timeline first, then what we'd do differently, in the same format as the last one
rank each feature by how many competitors have it, as a percentage, so the gaps everyone else has filled show first
we agreed on options 1 and 3 in the meeting… write them up as tickets with simple test steps, and link each one to the design
[a colleague] suggested we check this automatically on every release… is it ticketed already? If not, write one

cards.title: Mocking up screens from Figma designs

examples.text: get 3 agents to mock up the new settings page and 2 to review their work, back and forth until it matches the Figma
[the designer] updated the designs, pull the latest from Figma and update your mock
I want one board per step of the sign-up flow, on mobile and desktop
write a short update for the team channel for anyone who missed the outage call
turn this into bullet points… who else should we thank?
draft a message announcing the new dashboard… make it sound friendly, not like a press release
